notes.title: Update April 1
notes.content:
v.1.0.2.0

[h3][b]<Bug Fixes>[/b][/h3]
- Fixed an issue in which you get locked out of continuing the story once an error message appears in Chapter 5 in the main game.
- Fixed an issue in which you get locked out of continuing the story once an error message appears after completing Challege No. 24 and obtaining Griffin Lord in both the main game and the demo version.
- Fixed several inconsistencies in the name of the item, Large Light Feather, in the Traditional Chinese and the Simplified Chinese versions of the game.

[h3][b]<Others>[/b][/h3]
- The image used at the end of the demo version has been updated.

We have also identified the bugs below.
- After using Peppermint's skill, Somebody Help Me!, the game freezes when you run away from battle before the effect of the skill is applied.
Should this happen, restarting the game will solve this issue.
- The game crashes when you fast forward the dialogues in Chapter 14.
Please avoid using the fast forward function in Chapter 14.

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 14
notes.content:
If you’re reading this, that means PARTY RUSH!! has already been released!
Hooray!!
This will be our last entry, and we would like to present to you a message from the developer.

-----
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/506912f5114fc7db407045c13499043b897adc02.png[/img]

Hello, everyone.
I am Sechan, the developer of PARTY RUSH!!
PARTY RUSH!! is now available all over the world through Steam.
It means so much to me, and I would like to express my deepest gratitude to all those who have shown love to my game.

I started developing this game in 2015, when I was still in junior high school.
And I’ve put all my ideas and views on RPG Maker games into this game.
I hope that all of you will enjoy this game until the end to see all the twists and turns in the story.

Anyone with an interest in RPG Maker games or those who have actually made one will surely resonate with the story.
I truly hope that this game can bring an unforgettable experience to all of you who are playing RPG Maker games.

Thank you.
-----

We also hope that everyone will experience the game to the end to enjoy the story!

If you still haven’t, please check out the link below and add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 13
notes.content:
Time for our sneak peeks!
Have you all used some cool items in the demo?
Because this entry is going to be on just that!

In PARTY RUSH!!, there are various items that can help you out in your adventure.
Some items will heal you, some will give buffs, and some will damage your enemies.
For example, there is an item called “Large Light Feather” that will increase the agility of one of your characters.
You can use this to slow characters to counter their weakness or use it to an already fast character to speed them up as fast as thunderbolts and lightning!
That would definitely be very very frightening for your enemies, wouldn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/a0ceb085aa0e1c2dc71bbf1e57ff8df6d4b41529.gif[/img]

Most are a one-time-only items, but some special items can be used as many times as you want.
These items are generally very powerful and are not so easy to find.
So try going deep in the game to take advantage of these cool items!

You can also buy some items at Papaverine’s Store in the game, so collecting Rush, the in-game currency, would help in acquiring different types of items.
This is just a tiny hint before we go, but there is something in today’s entry that’s related to one of our achievements.

Well, that’s about it for today.
The last, but not least entry will be a special message, so don’t miss it!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist, and of course play our demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 11
notes.content:
Everyone enjoying the demo version?
This entry is on elements, whose understanding will most definitely help you fight against strong enemies in this game.
All right, let’s begin.

In this game, there are mainly two types of attacks: physical attacks and magic attacks.
And these attacks can also have some kind of element attached to it.
These elements include fire, water, lightning, ice, earth, rock, metal, and non-element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/dd432a53763504f8356c4609fd26fcb4252f86ed.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/372e97311f217f210ea7c96d9b7cd8290c5c3880.gif[/img]

The types and the elements that you use against certain enemies will affect the damage you deal to them. It’s really important to understand these differences in your attacks because depending on the enemies, they might be resistant, or even immune, to your attacks.

On the other hand, many enemies have their own vulnerabilities, and if you can find them, you might be able to deal massive damage.

But remember, the enemies are not the only ones vulnerable to their weaknesses. You too, might experience a crushing defeat if you aren’t careful enough.
The tips that appear in the game will give you more hints on types and elements, so please check them out!

The next entry will be on a character you will see early in the game!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist, and of course play our demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 10
notes.content:
Hi, did you all check out some good games at the Steam Next Fest?
We have also released the demo version of PARTY RUSH!!, so please try it out!

This entry will be on something called the combined skill. And knowing how to use this will greatly help your journey in the world of PARTY RUSH!!

First of all, a combined skill is a skill that you may use only when specific characters are together in your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/3dd8b113371c3fc2ab210b7d77fc31fae13250bd.gif[/img]

There’s a wide variety of them, so you’ll have to see for yourself.
Some are powerful attacks.
Some will weaken your enemies.
And some will even heal your party members!

Try to look into the types of characters you include in your party, and you might just find your very own combination that enables you to use a combined skill. Remember, there are close to 160,000 patterns. Hope you enjoy trying out different combinations!

Some combined skills can completely turn the tide of tough battles.
However, even powerful skills such as these might not be enough to solve everything if you ignore the elements.

As you might have suspected, the next entry will be on elements!
Have a good day!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 9
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!
Did you all play the demo version?
Today’s entry will be on one of the important characters who became the first member of Peppermint’s party: John!

John is an imp from another dimension summoned by Peppermint for the first time.
He’s a cheeky little chap who calls himself “the great imp.” His cockiness is presented to everyone, even towards Lemon Wine (Peppermint's boss) or Peppermint, his contractor. 
One might even say his cockiness is “imp”artial. Wink wink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/031d816f2cad82ba47226e6ed64e7d1cd34ce91a.gif[/img]

John’s forte is his speed. Put him in your party to start off the fight in your favor!
The lightning ball that he can shoot out is a useful skill that requires only a small amount of MP.
Also, he can use both physical and magic attacks, so he’s a very versatile character for beginner and advanced players!

Now that you know all about Peppermint’s sidekick, John, try using him in the game!
There’s no doubt he’ll be of great help!

The next entry will be on combined skills!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 8
notes.content:

-----

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 7
notes.content:
So far, what we’ve talked about are the basics.
Now let’s go into the beefy bit of the game.
The “Challenge!”

Choose “Complete the challenge!” inside the “Explore” menu.
Naturally, you will have to complete some challenging fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/224e84e9e1a45a2046e50c12c04bcc581b61b40a.gif[/img]

Here, you will be facing various enemies under different circumstances.
Some challenges will require you to have fewer party members than what you normally have.
Some will even force you to include certain characters in your party.

And now this is the bit I bet many are eager to know.
When you complete a challenge, you will receive some kind of reward.
This includes useful items, Fragment of the World, and even characters that can join your party!

As the word “challenge” suggests, the enemies that you will encounter are not easily dealt with.
So, if you can overcome the challenges, that knowledge will definitely help you out in the main game.

All in all, they are challenging, but it will be worth it!

For the next entry, we are preparing something special, so don’t miss it!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 6
notes.content:
Now that you know how to get tons of allies, the next step is to know how to form a party!
I mean, the name of the game is PARTY RUSH!!, so obviously, “party” is a big element in this game.

First, you need to choose “Party” in the main menu.
Then choose “Change your party!”, which will take you to a place where all your allies are chilling out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/90410e990ad9e6b33e073179138ecd1f8761fedf.gif[/img]

For you to include a character in your party, you just need to talk to them.
One thing we would like you to consider when choosing characters is the combination of characters in your party.
Certain characters put together will enable Peppermint to use special skills called “combined skill.”
So try to form a party fit to whatever situation you will be putting yourself in.

As you would know by now, there are many many characters in this game.
We can’t wait to see all the unique combinations of characters you will be using!

All right, well, next time, we will be talking about the challenges which will test your skills in party making!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 5
notes.content:
Hey there!
So last time we talked about exploration.
Today we would like to present another way to find many allies to join your journey.

Choose “Party” in the main menu in order to summon new allies or organize your party members.
This "summon" is not the same as what Peppermint does during battle. Here, the beings from other dimensions will stay with you permanently!
The only thing you need is a special item called the Fragment of the World. Each Fragment will let you summon one character at random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/3de95f4bb75202d90d756ddc3fe180356779b3b1.gif[/img]

The characters that you have summoned can be put into your party to assist your adventure.
And believe me, there are tons of characters available only through this way.
The Fragment of the World can be obtained throughout the game, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to summon characters!

By the way, the Fragment of the World can be purchased as well, but not with real money. Use the currency “Rush”, which you will be seeing in the game.
You can collect Rush in various ways, including story missions and exploration.
Collect some Rush to buy the Fragments, collect some Fragments to summon characters, summon characters to take them with you to missions, and take on missions to collect Rush!
What an amazing cycle!

Well, the next entry will be on party organization.
See you next time!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 4
notes.content:
Hi, all!
I think we’ve had enough talk on the battle system for now.
So let’s go into a different aspect of the game: the exploration!

Choose “Explore” in the main menu in order to go into the field map of Crimson Waffle Continent, in which you will find, amongst many, a nature-rich forest, a mysterious ruin in a plateau, and a shop with a bear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/96aa65f90978cee84310a2bfc05f1c24079c1af9.gif[/img]

Missions can also be found on the map.
In some missions, you might find people, or creatures, who would like to join your adventure.
And remember, you might find different missions on different days of the week.
So we recommend you to check the map as frequently as possible!

Explore the vast continent to take on missions and strengthen your force!
…Wow, isn’t exploring awesome?
Full of fortune and glory.
Oh, but exploration isn’t the only way to find those that will join you.
And this, our dear viewers, will be the topic of our next entry!

Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 3
notes.content:
Let’s talk about how Peppermint joins the battle scenes in this game!

The skill Peppermint has is called “Somebody Help Me.”
This skill let’s her summon somebody randomly from another dimension to fight on behalf of her.
So the action during Peppermint’s turn completely depends on who that “somebody” is!
Also, all these characters can only be seen through this skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/37320ac4dc8643fd40eaa25af6694f6db8885598.gif[/img]

Peppermint has a lot of MP, which gives her the upper hand to many other characters when it comes to long battles.
Although the unpredictability of her skill can be concerning at times, she has great potential in changing the tide of tough situations.

She can’t fight on her own, but she has many allies that will help her!
And that’s how she rolls.

Well, we’ve talked about fighting twice in a row now, so we would like to go into other aspects of the game next time.
We hope to see you again next week!

Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 2
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
Time for our sneak peek!

Today’s entry is the battle system.
To be honest, this entry might seem basic for an RPG fanatic, but bear with us.
It’s almost like a beginner’s guide for RPG games.

Anyways, let’s go into what you can do in a battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/86378a27f89ba14777bbb954f00417e1516df61c.gif[/img]
Note: Images are that of the game still in development and the contents are subject to change.

In a battle, every time it’s one of your characters’ turn, you can choose your action from your skills. Most skills require MP, or magic point. So, it’s really important to plan how to use MP in battles, especially in the tough ones.

To regain your MP, you can use “MP recovery”, which will take a turn. Choose your moments wisely when you want to recover MP. I mean, what’s the point of having MP if you’re dead, right?

You can also use items during a battle.
Some will heal you, and some will damage your foes.
Prepare yourself with abundant items at a shop or in the story before tough battles.

Well, that’s about it for the battle system.
I think I hear people asking, “But I thought Peppermint can’t fight?”
You are correct!
Check out our next entry, which will be about how Peppermint CAN fight.

Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/

notes.title: Sneak Peeks Vol. 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
We’ll be posting all kinds of information on the game from today to the release day!
They will include systems, characters, and even stories behind the development.
We hope you enjoy!

Our first entry is Peppermint, our beloved protagonist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593057/146121f77d5195c71c559ab0279e8eb111c6d783.gif[/img]

Peppermint seems to be an ordinary high school student.
Anxious and insecure.
You know, a typical student.

Now isn’t it awesome to know that this ordinary student is our protagonist saving this world?
She’s a Party Maker.
She can summon beings from other dimensions to fight her foes.
But you never know who would respond to her cry of help.
You can attack. You can heal. You can do all kinds of things!
It all just depends on who she can summon.

Oh wait, one more thing.
Although it’s a turn-based RPG, she can’t directly fight in battles.
But guess what?
She ain’t a fighter, but she’ll fight to save her world.

Next entry will be on the battle system.
Check it out to see how you fight in the game!


Don’t forget to add this to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693970/PARTY_RUSH/
